notes.title: Hotfix (Release-1.0.8)
notes.notes:
Hotfix

Fixed "Daily Life" and "Lawless Area" achievement trouble that unlocked when leave the game in saloon.

notes.title: Update Notes (Release-1.0.7)
notes.notes:
Changes

Experience requirements of reputation are decreased.


Considering the average playtime of users, I decide decrease the experience requirements of reputation. Now can play contents faster.

notes.title: Update Note (Preview-0.0.3)
notes.notes:
Updates

Credit required amount of weapon upgrades are decreased.
New difficulty "Playground" is added. It's a easy difficulty for beginner.


Bug Fixes

Fixed resolution trouble that some UI not properly sized.


I received comments that the game is so difficult from most of the users. I think the problem caused by the balance that was tested by only the developer without other testers. But also I think that hard difficulty has a merit like challenge purpose. So I decide don't touch the existing difficulty possibly  and adding new easy difficulty.

This updates of demo version is also applied to main game. Thanks for your playing.
